entries.name: Cross-boundary relational structure
entries.disposition: cross-boundary mapping from static geometry through residual producer to dynamic cocycle; exact transpose pairs expose a boundary-sensitive split

entries.name: Constraint-structure discovery
entries.disposition: line-family subsets, closure guards, residual realizability constraints and cocycle equations were explicitly varied/falsified

entries.name: Interface / port correspondence
entries.disposition: binary-group boundaries and residual/cofactor transition interfaces were represented through DTS

entries.name: Dependency-topology discovery
entries.disposition: rank-graded binary inheritance DAG separates cycle opportunity from cocycle frustration

entries.name: QU / open-region topology
entries.disposition: QU-SC-001/004/006 remain structured open regions and were narrowed by discovery

entries.name: Repeated relational motifs
entries.disposition: action-order motif search found a perfect k4 finite classifier but holdout coverage was incomplete

entries.name: Alternative-factorization discovery
entries.disposition: useful factorization into static line hypergraph, cycle opportunity and cocycle frustration

entries.name: Residual-structure discovery after partial match
entries.disposition: open-cap deletion residue, unexplained deletion coverage gap and gravity-relative residual remain visible

entries.name: Symmetry / automorphism discovery
entries.disposition: column automorphism/canonicalization, gauge flips and exact coordinate transpose were all exercised

entries.name: Role-equivalent elements under different labels
entries.disposition: role-equivalent columns/action labels were quotient-tested; first-occurrence relabeling survived only as a discovery clue

entries.name: Invariants across admissible variation
entries.disposition: gauge-flip invariance, final-cap cocycle invariance and open-cap pruning invariance were established in tested scopes
entries.pending_refinement: EW-012 may refine gravity-realizability interpretation; protocol itself is already dispositioned.

entries.name: Known/unknown interface correspondence
entries.disposition: known/unknown interfaces were preserved through QU; no convenient realization was selected

entries.name: Multi-scale common substructure
entries.disposition: state/residual, binary-transition and cycle-level views were compared without collapsing scales

entries.name: Transformation-invariant discovery
entries.disposition: gauge transformations and representation refinements preserve declared results; coordinate transpose does not preserve dynamic cocycle

entries.name: Information-flow structure
entries.disposition: sheet-delta information flow through ordered binary continuations is load-bearing; coarse local summaries do not recover syndrome

entries.name: Causal / temporal structure
entries.disposition: rank/action ordering and gravity-relative support semantics are load-bearing candidates; static hypergraph is insufficient
entries.pending_refinement: EW-012 may refine gravity-realizability interpretation; protocol itself is already dispositioned.

entries.name: Containment / ownership structure
entries.disposition: winning-line family containment and residual ownership were used in minimum-family and deletion analyses

entries.name: Cardinality / multiplicity structure
entries.disposition: equal cell/line counts and nonzero cycle rank are insufficient to determine frustration

entries.name: Dual / reversed structures
entries.disposition: 4x5/5x4 transpose duals are exact in static line geometry but split dynamically under gravity

entries.name: Complement / exclusion structure
entries.disposition: flat/obstructed subset exclusions and exact minimum-family complements were tested; no universal complement law promoted

entries.name: Fixed-point / recurrence structure
entries.disposition: recursive quotient fixed-point structure was exercised; no new domain recurrence theorem was inferred

entries.name: Compositional-structure discovery
entries.disposition: H+D synergy at k4 and multiple k3 obstruction channels expose nontrivial composition

entries.name: Reconstruction-structure discovery
entries.disposition: primitive producer reconstruction, witness reconstruction and exact transpose mapping were checked

entries.name: Proof / witness topology
entries.disposition: globally minimum contradictory proof/witness topology is two length-2 opposite-parity routes

entries.name: Refinement-relation discovery
entries.disposition: column refinements/canonicalization preserve semantics while reducing search; QUs were narrowed rather than collapsed

entries.name: Boundary-movement invariance
entries.disposition: moving from a static transpose view to gravity-relative transition boundaries changes the structural verdict

entries.name: Parameter-role correspondence
entries.disposition: width/height, k, frontier/cap and line-family roles were explicitly separated
entries.pending_refinement: EW-012 may refine gravity-realizability interpretation; protocol itself is already dispositioned.

entries.name: Dimensional / unit structure
entries.disposition: no physical-unit structure exists in the target; dimensional search reduced to board/connect parameters already covered by DP-27

entries.name: Ordering / partial-order structure
entries.disposition: ordered route/action structure distinguishes candidate mechanisms that endpoint/coarse summaries miss

entries.name: Reachability / connectivity structure
entries.disposition: cycle opportunity/reachability is necessary for syndrome but not sufficient; 5x3/4x4 k3 controls are nonvacuous and flat

entries.name: Conservation / balance structure
entries.disposition: gauge-invariant syndrome and static transpose incidence conservation were verified; dynamic cocycle need not be conserved by transpose

entries.name: Threshold / phase-boundary structure
entries.disposition: k2/k3/k4 and the k3 neighborhood expose finite phase boundaries; no unbounded threshold theorem promoted

entries.name: Degenerate / special-case structure
entries.disposition: k2 zero-cycle controls and rank-zero-opportunity cases were treated as special cases, not universal evidence

entries.name: Failure-mode correspondence
entries.disposition: flat/obstructed failure modes were compared with matched coarse signatures, matched static hypergraphs and merge anatomy

entries.name: Exception-structure discovery
entries.disposition: 4x5 is an exact flat exception to several otherwise tempting 5x4 mechanisms; exceptions were preserved rather than normalized away

entries.name: Representation-redundancy discovery
entries.disposition: canonicalization/permutation enumeration is representationally redundant by orders of magnitude

entries.name: Equivalent constraint-closure discovery
entries.disposition: final-cap and open-cap closure changes can alter carriers without changing cocycle; frontier changes magnitude but not classification
entries.pending_refinement: EW-012 may refine gravity-realizability interpretation; protocol itself is already dispositioned.

entries.name: Semantic-identity candidate discovery
entries.disposition: semantic-identity candidates were asked through NEI 0.4; no admissible natural/domain identity model family was available

entries.name: QUI extension from partial unknown correspondence
entries.disposition: unknown-correspondence search narrowed existing QUs; no exact QUI was promoted without identity/anchor authority

entries.name: Global whole-structure isomorphism
entries.disposition: exact static transpose isomorphisms exist, but no cocycle-preserving whole dynamic isomorphism can identify flat and frustrated pairs

entries.name: Literal-value coincidence
entries.disposition: literal equalities such as cell count, total line count or cycle opportunity were falsified as sufficient explanations

entries.name: Lexical / name similarity
entries.disposition: lexical similarity supplied no semantic evidence

entries.name: Shared ontology / class-label hints
entries.disposition: shared labels H/V/D are not sufficient: identical family labels can be flat on 4x5 and obstructed on 5x4

entries.name: Serialization / layout similarity
entries.disposition: serialization/layout choices were controlled by exact canonicalization and did not supply discovery authority

entries.name: Raw identifier correspondence
entries.disposition: raw class/group/edge identifiers are gauge/representation handles and were never used as explanatory evidence
